text:
leo: Heads up — seeing ~18x spike in fnhook validator rejects on /run-tool in ap-southeast since 10:47 UTC.
jen: Any error snippets?
leo: Tail from validator stream:
```
2026-06-12T10:47:01Z validator=fnhook route=/run-tool region=ap-southeast error="schema: expected OBJECT got ARRAY" sample=rz11
2026-06-12T10:47:02Z validator=fnhook route=/run-tool region=ap-southeast error="toolcall: missing required 'name'" sample=rz12
```
amir: We rolled permissive-coercion=true for a 10% canary in that region last night (rollout-0.22). Glue might be mapping lists -> toolcalls incorrectly under coercion.
jen: Console shows these as "REJECTED" and billing-bot already flagged a charge spike for customers on that route.
billing-bot: alert: anomalous fncall billing on /run-tool in ap-southeast — +450% deviation.
ops-oncall: If billed we should mute alerts while we triage. I'll hold billing alarms for 45m if ops agrees.
amir: Quick mitigations: (1) bump validator sampling to 100% for /run-tool in ap-southeast for 15m, (2) rollback permissive-coercion for canary in region, (3) short router patch: do not tag requests as billable fncall when validator.reject==true and fallback==degen until policy finishes.
jen: +1 to router patch, that will avoid false billing during transient validation noise. Also UX ask: console currently shows only "REJECTED" counts. Can we surface "shape: ARRAY"/"OBJECT" badge, and a one-click sample viewer (last 3 ids)? That speeds ops.
amir: Telemetry add: metric validator.shape_type{route,region,validator} and validator.reject_reason label. Also emit billing_exempt=true when fallback==degen && validator.reject_reason matches known coercion-canary patterns.
leo: I'll capture 3 representative sample ids once sampling is 100% and attach to ENG-21022. For now I'm flipping sampling and queuing rollback. deploy-bot: rollback permissive-coercion for canary ap-southeast (actor=leo).
deploy-bot: rollback job queued by leo — job=12177, expected complete ~10:49 :rocket:
console-bot: created ticket ENG-21022 (dashboard: shape badge + sample viewer + billing_exempt flag).
ops-oncall: Muted billing alerts for /run-tool ap-southeast for 45m (mute id M-5033).
leo: Early signal post-rollback shows rejects dropping; keeping 100% sampling for 15m. Will paste samples to ENG-21022. thread_ts=1810000000 :thumbsup:
